card.architecture: Mage-Flow 4B native-resolution MMDiT (Mage-VAE tokenizer + Qwen3-VL-4B encoder, rectified flow), RL-aligned
card.summary: Microsoft's compact 4B text-to-image model at native resolution (512-2048 per side, any aspect including extreme 4:1). RL-aligned build with full CFG and negative-prompt control; ~20 steps. Punches above its size against much larger open models.
card.pick_when: You want a small, fast, native-resolution model with real CFG / negative control and strong prompt-following.

prompt.guidance: Descriptive natural-language prose (Qwen3-VL encoder); English recommended. Front-load the key subject and specify lighting/style. Full CFG -- guidance ~5 with negatives to suppress artifacts.
prompt.example: Analog film photograph, wide landscape, a lone figure in a long overcoat seen from behind on an empty snowy plain, a lone brutalist concrete canopy and a vintage fastback car beside a retro fuel pump, distant snow-capped mountains, muted earth-tone palette, soft daylight, subtle film grain
prompt.overview: Native-resolution 4B MMDiT with a Qwen3-VL encoder: write rich natural-language prompts, not booru tags. RL-aligned so it supports classifier-free guidance and negative prompts.
prompt.instructions: Write detailed natural-language descriptions (English recommended). As an RL-aligned CFG model it responds to guidance_scale ~5 and to negative prompts -- use negatives to remove artifacts / unwanted content. Native resolution 512-2048 on any aspect ratio (multiples of 16); ~20 steps.
do: Front-load the key subject/action and specify lighting
Try wide/tall native aspect ratios (up to 4:1)
prompt.negative_guidance: Supported and effective (true CFG at guidance ~5) -- leave empty by default; populate to suppress artifacts / unwanted content.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in a sentence or two, like you'd tell ChatGPT. More detail usually looks better.
ui_help.good_for: compact, prompt-faithful images at any aspect ratio
